additions.description: Gases added, in order. plan_blend gives them as mix_result_additions.

helium_pct.description: Helium % of the gas added: 100 for helium. Default 0.

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen % of the gas added: 100 oxygen, 21 air, 0 helium, 32 a nitrox bank.

pressure_added.description: Gauge pressure this gas adds (bar or psi, per units): the cylinder gauge after minus before.

current.description: The cylinder before gas goes in. plan_blend gives it as mix_result_current.

helium_pct.description: Helium % before the first addition. Default 0.

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen % in the cylinder before the first addition, as analysed. Air is 21.

pressure.description: Gauge pressure before the first addition (bar or psi, per units); 0 for empty.

environment.description: Altitude and temperatures. Default sea level, 20 °C, fill at ambient.

altitude.description: Altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (32800 ft). Lowers the surface pressure the math adds to gauge readings. Default 0.

ambient_temperature.description: Temperature the cylinder cools to (°C or °F, per units), -50 to 100 °C. Default 20 °C (68 °F).

fill_temperature.description: Gas temperature right after filling (°C or °F). Above ambient, the plan fills to a hot pressure that settles to the target. Default: ambient.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

name: mix_result

final.description: The mix and settled pressure; analyse to confirm.

settle.description: Cooling from the fill temperature to ambient.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

title: Mix after a fill
